nodes.description: Read the target segment/list (sales-outreach/*.md prospecting docs, TED leads pack, or a named account) and confirm which OutreachPipeline this run is: customer, partner, or investor.
Enrich the org + person record (outreach_orgs, persons tables via src/outreach/types.ts). Pull domain, industry, size, LinkedIn. Maps to OutreachStatus 'researched'.
A warm path exists (referral, conference, existing relationship) — request the intro before drafting cold copy. Maps to OutreachStatus 'intro_requested'.
Warm intro delivered by the connector. Draft references the intro context. Maps to OutreachStatus 'intro_made'.

Compose the outbound draft using src/outreach/prospect-email-templates.ts or the matching sales-outreach/ template (INTRO_*.md, LETTER_*.md, PITCH_*.md). Sender identity and signature per CLAUDE.md Sender Identity rule. Transport MUST be Amazon SES per Non-Negotiable Rule 4 — never Resend, regardless of what /email or other skill docs currently say.

RED zone, non-negotiable: outbound email requires explicit human approval before send (Auto-Mode Trust Boundary — 'outbound email' is BLOCKED/human-required). The executor MUST stop here and surface the drafted copy verbatim; it may only continue once the run state carries an explicit HIC approval for this exact draft. No auto-transition past this node is permitted under any circumstance.
Send the approved draft via Amazon SES (SMTP). Record the activity (outreach_activities). Maps to OutreachStatus 'contacted'.

Hold state; cadence scheduler (src/outreach/cadence.ts, scheduler.ts) governs follow-up timing. Inbound replies parsed by src/outreach/reply-parser.ts. A follow-up send is a NEW draft and re-enters HIC_APPROVAL_GATE — it never resends without fresh approval.
Prospect replied. Classify outcome (positive/neutral/negative/no_response/bounced). Maps to OutreachStatus 'responded'.
Meeting scheduled. Maps to OutreachStatus 'meeting_booked'. Handoff point to a human-led sales conversation — this graph does not model the meeting itself.
Commercial terms in discussion (pricing, pilot scope, procurement). Maps to OutreachStatus 'in_negotiation'.
Terminal — deal closed. Maps to OutreachStatus 'converted'. Feeds the MGD/CRC north-star (/mgd-report).
Terminal — prospect declined or disqualified at this stage. Maps to OutreachStatus 'passed'.
Terminal for this run, but re-enterable later (e.g. quarterly re-check). Maps to OutreachStatus 'parked'.
Send failed or bounced (deliverability issue, wrong address). Diagnose and correct before retrying.
